title: AI-Driven Financial Inclusion with Enhanced Consumer Protection via Mobile Networks in Zambia
summary: Zamtel is piloting mobile-network credit scoring and fraud detection. Improved borrowing access, incomes, and consumer protection remain intended benefits.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Zamtel is piloting mobile-network credit scoring and fraud detection. Improved borrowing access, incomes, and consumer protection remain intended benefits. Initial Zamtel pilot / project in progress.
purpose: Expand responsible credit access through existing mobile networks.
system: Zamtel AI credit-scoring and fraud-detection initiative

ratings.reason: Underserved borrowers are intended to gain access to credit and income opportunities.
Zamtel and financial partners are intended to extend lending and reduce fraud; no realized result is supplied.
